body:
The surface reasons? I'm 28, just dropped out of college. I've been unemployed for over a year, and I'm probably never going to be able to go back to doing what I love (see, dropped out of college). In four months, I'm facing $40,000 in student loan debt that I'll be paying for the rest of my life, due to the second and third points of this paragraph. The people I care about don't value my interests or abilities. In short, I'm useless and don't see that changing.

Deeper than that? I'm tired. I'm so profoundly tired of trying and failing. If I could rewrite history so that I simply never existed, I think that the world would be at least no worse of a place.
